index_states.invalid: exact migration53 shape; indislive is true and indisvalid or indisready is false
index_states.drop_incomplete: exact migration53 shape; indisvalid, indisready and indislive are all false after an interrupted concurrent drop
index_states.unexpected: named object exists but is neither the exact valid index nor a recognized recoverable residue

prebuild.transport_requirement: controller timeout must exceed120s plus connection and short-check overhead; any interrupted transport remains unknown and must be inspected before another action

output: psql -X -q -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1; exactly one final JSON document on stdout after successful action
